{{Top|leg}}
'''Atmosphere towers''' were used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to produce breathable air. This allowed inhabitants of the planet to survive on the surface using only a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] rather than a full [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suits]]. The towers catalyzed raw rocks into gases such as [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]], [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]], and [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]]. Under [[Moruth Doole]]'s regime, he dialled the production back to sixty-eight percent.
